name: Short-Stay Visa / Visa-Free Entry (Schengen)

requirements.blocker_text: Luxembourg applies the Schengen short-stay rule: up to 90 days within any 180-day period, whether entering visa-free or on a Schengen (Type C) visa.
Nationals of countries not covered by EU Regulation 2018/1806's visa-exemption list must obtain a Schengen short-stay visa before travel; others may enter visa-free for the same 90/180-day allowance.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Schengen visa at a Luxembourg embassy/consulate if not visa-exempt.

sources.title: Guichet.lu (Luxembourg public administration portal) -- Staying and/or Working in Luxembourg for More Than 90 Days as an EU Citizen: implies the Schengen 90-day short-stay baseline
